scope: Source38/39 bounded tests, explicit CPU identity and actual kernel-B glibc diagnostic success; stress preparation and bounded engineering host sample.
limitations: P02 remains incomplete. Physical x86 reference, complete CPU/FP/ISA semantics, systemd acceptance, real block/network stress and hosted CI remain open.
Pass counts exclude the one disabled physical test and one optional XCTest skip, and are not summed across overlapping gates.

Original Dory-v1 identity is unchanged. The new explicitly selected Intel-compatible-v1 engineering profile changes vendor/signature, not advertised feature masks; no higher ISA level or physical CPU equivalence is claimed.

Glibc probe3 is a real source39/kernel6.18.36/glibc2.39 seven-workload success with host ACPI S5. This does not qualify systemd or all workloads, and is not an exact-state comparison with the earlier source32 musl pair.

All timings, JIT counters and the bounded host sample are engineering measurements on an experimental host with concurrent work. Live negative-cache reasons are capped site observations, not cumulative reason totals.
Stress fixture preparation checks alone do not imply successful guest stress, persistent storage durability or device-backed network acceptance.
